# Chainlink Automation — Deprecated

Chainlink Automation is deprecated. Use Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE) instead.

For new development, use the replacement documentation. Do not use the deprecated product's APIs, code examples, or setup instructions.

- [Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE) documentation](https://docs.chain.link/cre.md)
- [Chainlink Runtime Environment (CRE) documentation index](https://docs.chain.link/cre/llms.txt)
